description: Uploads one HTML prototype to Better Design and returns a better-design.com link a team opens in a browser and comments on, pinned to elements. Send one self-contained page: inline its CSS and scripts, or load them from https links. It runs sandboxed and cannot call any API. To share a fixed version on the same link, pass the prototypeId the first share returned. Read the team's notes with read-prototype-comments.

context.description: Optional. One sentence on WHY you are calling this and what the user asked for (e.g. 'adding nav icons for the fintech dashboard'). Used for usage analytics, and to pick the next step a UI or UX principle answer ends with. It does not change what the tool finds.

html.description: The whole page as HTML, at most 5 MB.

prototypeId.description: The id of a prototype this account shared before, to add a new version on the same link.

title.description: What the prototype shows, such as "Checkout flow".

visibility.description: Who can open it. workspace (the default for a new prototype): the owner and their workspace members. link: anyone with the link; commenting still needs an account.

name: share-prototype
title: Share a Prototype
